sources.entry: lucinate — Go-based terminal-native TUI chat client for interacting with AI agents via OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Features streaming responses, markdown rendering, tool call cards, local skills, cron management, session browsing, and multi-agent support. MIT. → Website · Homebrew

summary.one_liner: lucinate is a Go-based terminal chat client (TUI) for talking to AI agents through OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the listing metadata from eudk/awesome-ai-tools. According to that listing, lucinate is a terminal-native TUI that connects to OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The listing says it supports streaming responses, markdown rendering, tool call cards, local skills, cron management, session browsing, and multi-agent use. These features are not confirmed against the repository itself.
use_cases: chat with AI agents from the terminal
connect a terminal UI to an OpenClaw gateway
use Hermes profiles from a command-line chat client
manage multiple AI agents in one terminal session
notable: Terminal-native TUI for AI agent chat
Works with OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (per listing)
